purpose: Generate and re-import a PM-editable proposal table-of-contents workbook without treating the workbook as canonical machine state.
supported_scope: A3 counted as two RFP pages
PM workbook re-import and change classification
future RPA structural specification held until explicit release

blocking_gates: human proposal-mode declaration is checked against the RFP consortium policy
operations: assign stable source, node, requirement, obligation, and mapping identifiers
preserve RFP-fixed node level and parent
place detailed requirements below the applicable RFP-fixed parent
assign exactly one MAIN mapping per atomic obligation unless destination is CONTROL
allocate exactly the RFP target page count
emit PM-visible fields separately from machine fields
capture a baseline snapshot before human editing
emit the RPA specification in HOLD state

reimport_contract.new_row_rule: A row without a known node_id is NEW and receives a provisional stable identifier before comparison.
reimport_contract.deleted_row_rule: A baseline node missing from the re-import is DELETED and requires structural review.
reimport_contract.regeneration_rule: No TOC or RPA specification is regenerated after re-import without an explicit human command.

invariants.official_structure: RFP-fixed parent and level cannot change; title may change.
invariants.level_limit: Levels 1 through 3 are routine; level 4 is schema-valid but non-routine and requires review.
invariants.page_rule: The sum of leaf counted_pages must equal target_pages exactly.
invariants.a3_rule: For a leaf, counted_pages equals physical_sheets multiplied by two when a3_checked is true, otherwise by one.
invariants.main_rule: Each non-CONTROL atomic obligation has exactly one MAIN mapping; SUB may be zero or more.
invariants.consortium_rule: Human declaration is compared with RFP policy; a prohibited consortium condition produces HOLD.
invariants.owner_rule: Owner changes are preserved for humans and excluded from LLM impact classification.
invariants.release_rule: RPA release requires exact pages, passed LLM review, passed human review, no unresolved blocking conflict, and an explicit human release command.

non_goals: automatic regeneration after every external input
generalization beyond the three planned RFP cases
reopening_conditions: case 2 or case 3 cannot be represented without semantic loss
native Excel row insertion cannot be normalized safely
A3 or page allocation produces an undetected mismatch
MAIN ownership cannot be resolved by the RFP hierarchy
a structural change is misclassified as local or review-only
the contract causes material PM rework instead of reducing it
